subject: Short-term sandbox headroom for latency/throughput soak
messages:
From: Ami Shah <ami@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: 2026-08-11T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short-term sandbox headroom for latency/throughput soak

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Redwood runtime looks promising. We want to run a 48–72 hour soak in our sandbox next weekend to validate end-to-end latency under steady-state load and a short ramp to peak. High-level targets:~
- Sustained token throughput: ~250k tokens/hour~
- Concurrency: ~60–80 simultaneous sessions~
- 90th pct latency goal: <250ms per token for median prompt lengths

Our current trial cap will be exhausted before we complete the run. Can Redwood issue a short-term quota uplift or promo voucher for ~500,000 tokens (one-time) or a temporary sandbox headroom window (48–72h) that we can schedule for Aug 14–16 PST? We’ll share the POC test plan (attached).

Also copying procurement for any paperwork.

Thanks,
Ami Shah
Senior Product Manager
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: POC_Test_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, ~6 sheets)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ami Shah <ami@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: 2026-08-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term sandbox headroom for latency/throughput soak

Ami — thanks for the clear targets and the test plan. We can support a short soak but need a couple of details before I route this to credits approval:~
- Exact token estimate by hour (you listed ~250k tokens/hr; confirm total tokens for the 48 vs 72h window)~
- Do you need the capacity as a single voucher code or a temporary quota uplift on your account?~
- Will you be using streaming responses and function calling (affects token accounting)?

I’m looping in Ben (SE) to validate the runtime config and Marissa (manager) for one-time promo approval if the total exceeds our standard trial allowance. I’ll follow up within the hour.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.inference.com | (415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ami Shah <ami@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term sandbox headroom for latency/throughput soak

On Tue, Aug 11, 2026 at 10:03 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Ami — thanks for the clear targets and the test plan. We can support a short soak but need a couple of details...

Quick technical check from my side: the numbers look doable with a dedicated sandbox window and modest batching. A couple of notes:~
- If they stream token-by-token and have high context windows, token burn could be ~25–40% higher. Recommend we assume a 30% headroom: for 250k/hr sustained over 72h that’s ~23M tokens total (including headroom).~
- Suggest we provision as a temporary quota uplift tied to their account for a precise window (Aug 14 08:00 PDT -> Aug 16 20:00 PDT), rather than a single voucher code — easier for billing reconciliation.
- We'll enable prefix/KV caching for the run to reduce cost where possible; need their engineers to whitelist our test IPs.

I attached a short risk checklist and failure-mode doc. If Marissa approves, I can lock in the window and coordinate with infra to reserve capacity.

—Ben Carter
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: POC_Failure_Modes.docx (bullet list of 8 scenarios)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term sandbox headroom for latency/throughput soak

Stephanie / Ben — OK to approve a one-time temporary uplift. Approve the following:~
- Token uplift: 25,000,000 tokens total allocated to Nimbus Analytics account (covers 72h with headroom)~
- Window: Aug 14 08:00 PDT -> Aug 16 20:00 PDT (ops to reserve capacity)~
- Condition: engineering must agree to the IP whitelist and run the baseline warmup script Ben outlined; product team to surface any regressions to us within 24h after the run.

I also want a short SOW amendment documenting the temporary uplift and that this is a non-billable trial credit tied to deal NW-POC-2026-047. Ben — please attach the draft SOW and link the HubSpot deal.

—Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_draft.pdf
Related: https://hubspot.example/deal/DEAL-20394
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ami Shah <ami@nimbus-analytics.com>, procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term sandbox headroom for latency/throughput soak

Ami — good news: we’ve applied a temporary uplift to your account per Marissa’s approval. Details below:~
- Token allocation: 25,000,000 tokens (one-time, non-billable)~
- Active window: Aug 14 08:00 PDT -> Aug 16 20:00 PDT~
- Voucher/code: AUTO-UPLIFT-NWPOC-2026-047 (applied to your account; no action required)~

Ben will coordinate the infra reservation and IP whitelist. I’ve also initiated a short SOW amendment for signatures — DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/sign/abcd1234 — procurement can sign to acknowledge the non-billable uplift. Attached are the SOW draft and the failure-modes checklist we discussed.

Let us know if you want a brief pre-run sync (Ben can host a 30-min tech call). Good luck with the soak — please share any anomalies and the post-run report.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.inference.com
Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf, POC_Failure_Modes.docx
